description: This file defines the interface JsonArrayBuilder, a builder pattern for constructing JSON arrays with fluent API methods for adding, setting, removing, and retrieving various types of JSON values. It includes method signatures for handling integers, longs, doubles, booleans, strings, and JsonValue objects, and supports method chaining.

classes.name: JsonArrayBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for creating JSON arrays with fluent API, supporting addition, replacement, removal, and retrieval of JSON values of various types.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds at least one int value to the JSON array to be built, with support for additional values and method chaining.

methods.name: addIntegers
methods.description: Adds all given Integer values to the array.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces the value at a specified index with an int, long, double, boolean, String, or JsonValue.

methods.name: addLongs
methods.description: Adds all given Long values to the array.

methods.name: addDoubles
methods.description: Adds all given Double values to the array.

methods.name: addBooleans
methods.description: Adds all given Boolean values to the array.

methods.name: addStrings
methods.description: Adds all given String values to the array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds at least one JsonValue to the array.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all given JsonValue objects to the array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonValue at a specified index, returning an Optional<JsonValue>.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the value at a specified index or a specific JsonValue from the array.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a new JsonArray containing all added values.
